comment: The DSP is the Parasite alternative firmware for Clouds, vendored at alt_firmware/parasites, in the Monsoon layout; src/etesia.cpp is the Rack wrapper, resampling to the hardware's 32kHz. It adds two modes to Nebulae — the Oliverb reverb and the Resonestor resonator — along with more grain envelopes, smaller grains, and a REVERSE button and gate that play the buffer backwards. Every jack is read with getVoltage() or getVoltageSum(), so nothing here is polyphonic. The right audio input is normalled to the left at etesia.cpp:215. The freeze gate, the reverse gate and the trigger all read high at 1V, which the manual gives only for reverse. Both gates are OR-ed with their buttons, so either one turns the setting on. The hardware's ability to save and load the audio buffer is not implemented, and the maker says so in a footnote.
